# Proverbs 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Hear, sons, discipline-of a-father, and-attend to-know understanding.

**2** For good instruction I-give to-you; my-teaching do-not-forsake.

**3** For a-son I-was to-my-father, tender and-only-one before my-mother.

**4** And-he-taught-me and-said to-me, 'Let-your-heart hold-fast my-words; keep my-commandments and-live.

**5** Acquire wisdom, acquire understanding; do-not-forget and-do-not-turn-away from-[the]-words-of my-mouth.

**6** Do-not-forsake-her and-she-will-guard-you; love-her and-she-will-watch-over-you.

**7** Beginning-of wisdom: acquire wisdom, and-with-all your-acquiring acquire understanding.

**8** Exalt-her and-she-will-lift-you-up; she-will-honor-you when you-embrace-her.

**9** She-will-give to-your-head a-wreath-of grace; a-crown-of beauty she-will-bestow-on-you.'

**10** Hear, my-son, and-receive my-sayings, and-the-years-of life will-be-many for-you.

**11** In-[the]-way-of wisdom I-have-directed-you; I-have-led-you in-tracks-of uprightness.

**12** When-you-walk your-step will-not-be-straitened, and-if you-run you-will-not-stumble.

**13** Take-hold-of discipline; do-not-let-go; guard-her, for she [is] your-life.

**14** In-[the]-path-of [the]-wicked do-not-enter, and-do-not-walk in-[the]-way-of evil-ones.

**15** Avoid-it, do-not-pass through-it; turn-away from-it and-pass-on.

**16** For they-do-not-sleep unless they-do-evil, and-their-sleep is-robbed unless they-cause-stumbling.

**17** For they-eat bread-of wickedness, and-wine-of violence they-drink.

**18** But-[the]-path-of [the]-righteous [is]-like-[the]-light-of dawn, going and-brightening until [the]-full day.

**19** The-way-of [the]-wicked [is]-like-darkness; they-do-not-know at-what they-stumble.

**20** My-son, to-my-words attend; to-my-sayings incline your-ear.

**21** Let-them-not-slip from-your-eyes; keep-them in-[the]-midst-of your-heart.

**22** For life they [are] to-those-finding-them, and-to-all his-flesh healing.

**23** Above-all guarding, guard your-heart, for from-it [are the]-sources-of life.

**24** Put-away from-you crookedness-of mouth, and-perversity-of lips put-far from-you.

**25** Your-eyes — let-them-look straight-ahead, and-your-eyelids let-them-look-straight before-you.

**26** Make-level [the]-track-of your-foot, and-all your-ways will-be-established.

**27** Do-not-turn right or-left; remove your-foot from-evil.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **4:7**: Reshit hokhmah qeneh hokhmah — 'Beginning of wisdom: acquire wisdom.' The tautological form is deliberate — the first act of wisdom is to desire wisdom.

- **4:18**: Or nogah — 'light of dawn.' The image of progressively increasing light is one of the most beautiful metaphors in Proverbs.

- **4:23**: Mikkol-mishmar — 'above all guarding.' The heart (lev) in Hebrew thought is the seat of will, intellect, and emotion combined.

— EMET
